title: KOHLER Anthem Three-Outlet Recessed Mechanical Thermostatic Valve Control K-26347-9-SN

comparisons.notes: KOHLER K-26347-9 Anthem three-outlet control, Vibrant Polished Nickel variant $528

writeup: This is Kohler's Anthem three-outlet thermostatic shower control panel (K-26347-9, polished nickel), with a temperature knob and push-button outlets that pop out for flow adjustment up to 8 gpm. Woot has it new for $261.99 versus $528 at Easy Plumbing. Note it needs the separate K-39014 three-port valve.
